name: BitSearch
note: Metered: 200 requests a day to an address that sends no key, 1,000 with a free account's key sent as x-api-key (its own API page, read 2026-09-14), then refused until midnight UTC. That is what its 429s to Cloudflare's shared addresses always were, and what a relay met on 2026-09-14 after asking it on every fresh search. Off by default for that reason; a deployment with a key turns it on with TSP_ALSO and sends the key with TSP_INDEX_HEADERS. cache_s keeps each query's answer six hours, so the allowance goes on new questions. Worth it: a DHT-wide index that sees releases nothing else here does, Indian regional cinema among them. Its seeder counts are the number from the day it first saw a torrent, so a hosted deployment re-counts them. solidtorrents.to is a redirect chain to bitsearch.eu that times out from a data centre, so it is no longer listed.
